entries.label: The Dadra And Nagar Haveli And Daman And Diu

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Study In Abroad
fields.briefDescription: In the year 2010-11, Rajasthan Government has taken the initiative to encourage girl child education by starting a scheme to Study Abroad.

fields.schemeName: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – Kargil package scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for the Individual and family.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Hamari Betiyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantri Hamari Betiyan Yojana was launched in 2015-16 by centre under the secondary education department for the benefit of girls in their education.

fields.schemeName: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance
fields.briefDescription: "Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance" is a scheme by the Chief Minister's Secretariat, Govt. of Rajasthan. In case of death due to accident, ₹ 1,00,000 is provided. In case of serious injury, assistance is up to ₹ 20,000. The assistance is "one-time full-support".

fields.schemeName: NEET/JEE Coaching For Tribal Students
fields.briefDescription: NEET/JEE Coaching for tribal students scheme launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development in the year 2001.

fields.schemeName: Incentive To Girls
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan State started a scheme "Incentive for Girls" for state students.

fields.schemeName: Palanhar Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Palanhar Yojana has been started by the state government of Rajasthan to benefit the orphan and needy children of the state.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The state government has announced the implementation of 'Universal Health Coverage' in the state in the budget announcement 2021-22, in compliance of which Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme was started in the state from May 1, 2021.

fields.schemeName: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
fields.briefDescription: In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (Class 11 & 12) In the year 2011.

fields.schemeName: Widow B.Ed Scheme-Rajasthan
fields.briefDescription: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Widow B.Ed Scheme" for Widow/abandoned women.

fields.schemeName: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
fields.briefDescription: In the year 1984, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of the Schedule Tribe.

fields.schemeName: Competitive Exam Coaching
fields.briefDescription: Competitive exam Coaching for tribal students scheme was launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development Department in the year 2016-17, under which free coaching to tribal students for competitive examinations through Mankyi Lal Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Udaipur is provided.

fields.schemeName: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
fields.briefDescription: This scheme will be called "Reimbursement of expenditure incurred on visa for employment abroad to construction workers". The purpose of this scheme is to provide assistance to the registered beneficiaries employed in building and other construction works for better employment opportunities.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Specially Abled persons.

fields.schemeName: Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme" for Girls students.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Post-matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of students.

fields.schemeName: Beej Swalamban Yojna
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana was started in the year 2017-18 with the objective of producing quality improved seeds on their farms for their own use by the farmers.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Pre-Matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of Very Backward Class students.

fields.schemeName: Ghar Ghar Aushodhi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan government has planned a new scheme called Rajasthan Ghar Ghar Aushadhi Yojana to promote the use of Ayurvedic and medicinal herbs across the state.

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (College Level) In the year 1994-95.

fields.schemeName: Assistance Scheme For Construction Worker In Case Of General Or Accidental Death Or Injury
fields.briefDescription: This scheme will be called "Assistance Scheme for Beneficiary in Normal Death or Accident (in case of death or injury)" registered in Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. This scheme will be effective in entire Rajasthan.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The purpose of the Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana is to encourage people employed in Labour Department building, other construction works to participate in international sports by providing them incentives for participating and excelling in international sports.

fields.schemeName: Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, "Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed" scheme is run by the "Tribal Area Development Department" from 2004-05.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Rajasthan State government started the "Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana" scheme for very backward classes in 2011-12

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Sahariya tribal girls' higher education (Class 11 and 12).

fields.schemeName: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
fields.briefDescription: Financial help on death of family head scheme was launched by Rajasthan state government under tribal area development on 20/08/2008. Under this scheme, ₹10,000/- to the wife of the deceased on the premature death of the head of the family of Saharia primitive tribe.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Scooty Distribution And Incentive Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Rajasthan has launched the Devnarayan Chatra Scooty Yojana Scheme for the year 2023 in order to encourage female students in the state to study and to address the state’s low female literacy rate.

fields.schemeName: Cm Anuprati Coaching Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Rajasthan in India to provide free coaching to students from economically weaker sections (EWS) and socially backward communities for various competitive exams such as IAS, RAS, and other government job recruitment exams.

fields.schemeName: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
fields.briefDescription: In order to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan to study in top foreign universities of the world. The scheme commenced from 5th October 2021.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Rajasthan State government started the "Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana" scheme for women's support and empowerment.

fields.schemeName: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for Individual for Non BPL whose family income should be at least 2lakhs per annum.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana launched by Social Justice and empowerment in 2015 by Rajasthan for Family.

fields.schemeName: Zero Budget Natural Farming
fields.briefDescription: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote  natural farming.

fields.schemeName: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The benefit of Gargi Puraskar Yojana is given every year to the beneficiary girl child of Rajasthan on the day of Basant Panchami. This time also the beneficiary girl students were taken on a tour of the girl students on the occasion of Basant Panchami very year.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi Shehri Credit Card Yojana
fields.briefDescription:
Indira Gandhi Urban Credit Card Scheme-2021 is implemented to provide employment / self-employment opportunities in
urban areas and to provide financial resources for everyday needs.

fields.schemeName: Young Interns Program
fields.briefDescription: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government departments.
